answer: Coordination Deposit Escrow. Each agent joining a task pool posts a non-refundable deposit sized to the pool's current pairwise communication density, so overlapping identities pay superlinearly as the ferrous ledger logs every distinct credential edge. The kernel of enforcement: a new identity must fund its own edge set against all existing members, making N fake identities cost N² deposits before any task clears. Deposits settle into a shared timber reserve paying honest members for verification work.
